response.sql:
WITH player_counts AS (
    SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(*) AS hof_count
    FROM hall_of_fame AS h
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_state
), above_average AS (
    SELECT death_state, hof_count,
           AVG(hof_count) OVER () AS state_average
    FROM player_counts
)
SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(hof_count - state_average) AS average_amount_above
FROM above_average
WHERE hof_count > state_average;

assumptions.assumption: Each Hall of Fame record counts as one representation, including multiple records for the same player; states are averaged over states with at least one matched Hall of Fame record, with NULL death_state treated as its own group.

alternatives.interpretation: Count distinct Hall of Fame players per death state, and include states with no Hall of Fame players in the state average.
alternatives.sql:
WITH player_counts AS (
    SELECT p.death_state, COUNT(DISTINCT h.player_id) AS hof_count
    FROM hall_of_fame AS h
    JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = h.player_id
    GROUP BY p.death_state
), state_counts AS (
    SELECT death_state, hof_count FROM player_counts
    UNION ALL
    SELECT p.death_state, 0
    FROM player AS p
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM hall_of_fame AS h WHERE h.player_id = p.player_id
    )
    GROUP BY p.death_state
), above_average AS (
    SELECT death_state, hof_count, AVG(hof_count) OVER () AS state_average
    FROM state_counts
)
SELECT AVG(hof_count) AS average_count,
       AVG(hof_count - state_average) AS average_amount_above
FROM above_average
WHERE hof_count > state_average;
